body.name: Hong--Li numerical-delta implementation
body.construction: For fixed \(L\), after verifying Hadamard directional differentiability of the ambient map \(\phi\) at the observable law and conditional consistency of the multinomial bootstrap direction, compute \(T_n^{\star}=\{\phi(\widehat\mu_n+\varepsilon_nG_n^{\star})-\phi(\widehat\mu_n)\}/\varepsilon_n\), where \(\varepsilon_n\downarrow0\) and \(\sqrt n\,\varepsilon_n\to\infty\), and apply the pointwise numerical-delta theorem of Hong--Li. This is a direct implementation of their theorem, including at hinge ties and structural-zero cells once its tangent-space and bootstrap premises are checked, and is not a novel inferential claim.
